description:
Take an incredible journey to some of Europe’s most inspiring tourist destinations! 
Hike through gorgeous national parks, explore European musical culture, visit ancient castles, and much more! 
This hidden-object game is full of new and popular tourist spots, so use your skills and knowledge to solve mini-games and puzzles with a distinct European flare!

In this hidden object game you will be able to visit many both new and popular tourist places. 
To complete this game, you need to apply your skills and attention to cope with the mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes:
- 10 additional locations - continue your journey across Europe and search for our raccoon friend!
- 5 additional new mini-games + 12 more for puzzle lovers
- A collection of unique souvenirs
- 20 great  souvenirs from the journey
name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 7 Collector's Edition
intro: Embark on a journey through beautiful European countries!
